data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher15/Fisher02, help recruit individually. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but costs8 remaining tons and16 next-stock tons in the 25% case. Even all25 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Long-run gains aren't assured.
